question.problem: Find the inverse of the function $f(x)={log}_{2}⁡(x)+8.$
question.worked_solution:
To find ${f}^{-1}(x),$ we start by replacing $f(x)$ with $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y & ={log}_{2}⁡(x)+8\end{aligned}
$$

Now, interchanging $x$ and $y$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={log}_{2}⁡(y)+8.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we make $y$ the subject of the equations, as follows:        

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={log}_{2}⁡(y)+8 \\ {log}_{2}⁡(y) & =x-8 \\ {2}^{{log}_{2}⁡(y)} & ={2}^{x-8} \\ y & ={2}^{x-8}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse function is ${f}^{-1}(x)={2}^{x-8}.$
